decisions.replace_root: At depth 1, replace accepts only the tab's own root route (query or parameter changes), retaining its id; a different route leaves the value unchanged with one refusal.
decisions.chain_leaf: The leaf preserves its canonical incoming location, including query and escape spelling; ancestors format only their own parameters.
decisions.ids: Seed roots in declared tab order from zero before opening the launch chain; refuse before next exceeds the largest exactly representable JavaScript integer.
